The update had multiple balancing changes and a few bugfixes. This update encompassed four versions, the main v1.36.0 update (released 16 October 2024) and three minor updates, the v1.36.1 (released 16 October 2024), v1.36.2 (released 16 October 2024) and from +1 to +4. *[[Trapper]]'s firerate is now affected by [[Firerate Buff]]s. *Changed [[Gatling Gun]]'s Level 3 upgrade name from ''Double Trouble'' to ''Extra Barrel''. *Changed [[Scout]]'s Level 4 upgrade name from ''Double Tap'' to ''Akimbo Handguns''. *Changed default keybind for the sticker wheel from V to H. *Fixed [[Gatling Gun]] soft-locking itself when upgraded to quickly while the operator's avatar is still loading. *Fixed revives giving {{Exp|}} rewards from both the final loss/triumph and every single loss that player revived from, when it should only give it from the final one. *Fixed revives disabling [[Time Scale]]. *Fixed [[Lazy Couch]] gingerbread man not appearing. *Fixed [[Firework]] lighter not appearing. *Fixed [[Freezer]] and [[Toxic Gunner]] animations breaking after the first shot. :In '''v1.36.1''': *Fixed [[Slasher]] using icons of its reworked version. :In '''v1.36.2''': *Fixed multiple mobile buttons, such as sprint, emote, delete, rotate and sticker not appearing. :In '''v1.36.3''': *Fixed wave clear bonus not working. *Fixed tower pets levitating instead of walking on the ground. ==Gallery== {{Gallery|Open = Yes|
